analysis.session_summary: The window was dominated by broad USD strength, with DXY +0.669% to 104.409 and USD closing at its best. EUR/USD fell -88.4 pips to 1.08845, GBP/USD -84.4 to 1.30156, while USD/JPY rose +50.6 to 159.275. Data were mostly muted: German and French PMIs failed to move EUR, and USD's own Services PMI miss produced an inverted +0.043% USD gain. Late-session Nvidia headline sparked brief risk recoveries in AUD and NZD, but most pairs closed near lows/highs in USD's favor.

themes.evidence: DXY +0.669% to 104.409; USD strength +0.442% and closed at its best; EUR/USD -88.4 pips, GBP/USD -84.4 pips.

themes.theme: European data failed to support EUR
themes.evidence: German Services PMI beat 54.0 vs 52.4 but basket +0.020% muted; French Manufacturing PMI miss 47.9 vs 49.8 basket -0.023% muted.
Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang lifted AUD/USD +43.1 pips in a leg and Gold +1473.4 pips; VIX fell -5.971% to 24.014, but AUD/USD still closed -12.4 pips.

currency_drivers.USD: Closed at its best despite soft Services PMI miss; inverted move signals USD bought on weakness.
currency_drivers.EUR: German and French PMI beats were muted; no clear catalyst, weakest major.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own releases; early selling rejected, recovered 78% from -0.29%.
currency_drivers.GBP: Own Services PMI miss was muted; early gain fully faded.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own releases; early selling rejected, recovered 83% from -0.20%.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own releases; held its range.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own releases; attempt rejected, gave back 66% from +0.25%.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; held its range near lows.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD's +31.8 pip overnight bounce had no clear catalyst and was fully reversed by a -117.6 pip slide into the close, leaving it -88.4 pips at 1.08845 near session lows.

polarity_reads.read: USD strengthened despite a miss (54.7 vs 55.6 forecast), implying short-dollar positioning or haven demand rather than rate expectations.
EUR did not rally on a beat (54.0 vs 52.4 forecast); basket moved only +0.020%, confirming euro-negative positioning.
EUR did not accelerate lower on a miss (47.9 vs 49.8 forecast); basket moved -0.023%, showing no incremental EUR selling.
GBP muted on own miss (52.0 vs 53.0 forecast); basket moved -0.020%, indicating no panic but also no dip-buying.

scenarios.name: USD strength extends
scenarios.thesis: US exceptionalism and inverted USD data reaction persist; DXY closed at its best and USD strength is broad.
scenarios.invalidation: EUR/USD recovers above 1.08845 or DXY fails at 104.409.

pair_paths.rationale: USD closed at its best and EUR/USD near session lows; measured range offers room for another leg lower.
GBP faded its early gain and closed near lows; USD strength should keep pressure.
USD/JPY closed near highs at 159.275; yield support and USD momentum can extend.

scenarios.name: Consolidation / two-way chop
scenarios.thesis: After large USD move, pairs near extremes; event calendar is light and profit-taking may dominate.
scenarios.invalidation: DXY makes a new high above 104.409 or EUR/USD closes above 1.08845.

pair_paths.rationale: After -88.4 pip drop, pair may consolidate within its 124.6 pip range.
USD/JPY may hold 159.275 area within 108.2 pip range before next catalyst.

scenarios.name: USD pullback / risk-on
scenarios.thesis: VIX drop -5.971% and Nvidia headline may spur risk appetite, causing an overdue USD pullback.
scenarios.invalidation: DXY makes a new high above 104.409.

pair_paths.rationale: If VIX keeps falling and risk appetite returns, EUR/USD can retrace the -88.4 pip day move.
USD pullback unwinds the +50.6 pip day gain, safe-haven JPY bid.
AUD closed -12.4 but had strong Nvidia-driven recovery; can rally within 60.2 pip range.

risks.watch: 13:45 headline and any further tariff announcements.
